scope: Bug1 (idle-window before kill) + Bug2 (mkdir -p artifacts/ everywhere) hardening across active s43/s44 watcher scripts; canonical llama_lora variant already pre-patched on 2026-05-04 morning.
files_not_patched: state/p9_path_a_r16_2026_05_03/host_terminator_v2.txt (legacy single-pod variant; pod terminated; out of scope)

bug1_fix.description: Replaced single-shot kill on ALIVE=0/DONE=0 with 4-minute (240s) idle-window + recheck. Recheck branches: DONE=1 -> fall through to DONE-branch on next iter; ALIVE=1 -> false-alarm resume; both still 0 -> confirmed crash, then download log + terminate.
bug1_fix.rationale: Observed 1-3min/save flush on H100; original 5s window could kill pod mid-save.

bug2_fix.description: Inserted defensive `mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS"` before each scp in DONE-branch and error-branch, plus inside scp failure || branch (idiom: `|| { mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS"; echo ...fail >> $LOG; }`). Also quoted ARTIFACTS in startup mkdir.
bug2_fix.rationale: Prior fix-landed doc (host_pod_terminator_fix_landed_2026_05_04) showed scp silently failed when local artifacts/ absent on clean Mac state.

F-TERMINATOR-1.method: 3-scenario simulation (compressed IDLE_WAIT_SEC=1s) with mocked probe sequences

honest_c3_caveats: raw#10 caveat 1: behavior under live error-branch trigger NOT exercised end-to-end; falsifier is structural (bash -n + grep counts) + simulated logic (mock probe). Real H100 pod was not deliberately crashed.

raw#10 caveat 2: 240s idle window is heuristic-based (1-3min/save observed) — extreme tail saves (e.g., 4min+ checkpoint flush under disk contention) could still trigger false-positive kill. No empirical distribution of save durations beyond Path A r=16 sample.

raw#10 caveat 3: legacy `state/p9_path_a_r16_2026_05_03/host_terminator_v2.txt` was NOT patched (pod terminated, out of active scope). If that script is ever re-launched without re-applying the fix it will revert to single-shot kill behavior.

constraints_honored.raw#9: Mac-side .sh.txt parked form respected (no bare .sh; .sh.txt + new sim wrote .sh.txt after .sh creation was lost — likely external sweep on bare .sh extensions in state/).
